exam: 111年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員考試、111年公務人員特種考試國際經濟商務人員考試、111年公務人員特種考試民航人員考試、111年公務人員特種考試原住民族考試
subject: 外交實務英文寫作(以英文命題及作答)
classes: 外交領事人員英文組二

essays.text: An ocean-going fishing vessel registered in Taiwan (R.O.C.) has a bloodbathat sea. The vessel is drifting at sea about 1,000 nautical miles from Mauritius.Please issue a press release on behalf of the Taiwan’s Ministry of ForeignAffairs to explain how our government will employ all possible means toprovide assistance for the crew of the ship.（25%）

After Taiwan (R.O.C.) and the Republic of Nicaragua cut off diplomatic tiesin 2021, the Nicaraguan government confiscated the original premises ofTaiwan’s embassy in Nicaragua and handed it over to the P.R.C. Pleasecompose a formal letter of protest on behalf of the Ministry of Foreign Affairsof Taiwan to strongly condemn this act.（25%）

Suppose Taiwan (R.O.C.) and country X have a sovereignty dispute over theDiaoyutai Islets and their adjacent waters, Taiwan’s Ministry of ForeignAffairs has decided to submit an arbitration case to the Permanent Court ofArbitration in The Hague, Netherlands. Please draft the pleadings for the casein which the basis for Taiwan’s sovereignty over the Diaoyutai Islets isexplained in detail.（25%）

Sri Lanka is currently suffering from government bankruptcy and ongoingpolitical and economic turmoil, resulting in frequent local demonstrations anda serious lack of livelihood resources. Please issue a formal statement onbehalf of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Taiwan (R.O.C.) to explain howour government would respond to this matter.（25%）
